content.short: Scribble is a ConsenSys-managed tool for testing Solidity contracts by runtime verification.
content.description: Scribble is a build tool maintained by ConsenSys that provides access to Solidity contract properties for testing. Developers can instrument smart contracts into a formal specification language, exposing code to symbolic execution and fuzzing, among other tests. This approach integrates with broader testing workflows and can be used with MythX and other testing tools to support comprehensive contract analysis. Scribble therefore serves as a specialized testing aid in Ethereum and Multichain environments, facilitating verification workflows for smart contracts.
